newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Almost half Argentine unemployed are poor - report.
newsitem.headline: Almost half Argentine unemployed are poor - report.

text.p: More than half the 2.6 million unemployed people in Argentina live below the poverty line, according to an "official" report quoted by Clarin newspaper Tuesday.

A document said by Clarin to have been drawn up by the Labor Ministry shows 1.43 million unemployed urban or rural people live in poverty "with low skill levels and serious difficulties to reinsert themselves in the labor market."
The report only includes people aged 16 to 60 who are actively looking for a job and live in critical economic conditions, Clarin said.
It does not include those who gave up searching for a job or pensioners. If they were included, the total of unemployed people living in poverty would be even higher, Clarin said.
Unemployment in Argentina stands at 17.3 percent according to the most recent job survey last October.
